headline: SmolVLA：单卡可训的小型VLA模型
title_en: SmolVLA: A small Vision-Language-Action model you can train on one GPU
tagline_en: A compact VLA base model from Hugging Face that maps images and instructions to robot actions, trainable on a single GPU.
summary_md:
SmolVLA is a compact Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model released by Hugging Face as part of the LeRobot project. It takes multi-view images, robot proprioceptive state, and an optional language instruction as input, and outputs continuous actions. The model is trained with a flow matching objective and is intended as a base checkpoint to fine-tune on your own robot data.

Why it matters: most VLA models are large and expensive to train. SmolVLA is designed to be trainable on a single consumer GPU and deployable on affordable hardware, while per the paper aiming to match the performance of much larger VLAs through community-collected data. The weights, code, and example datasets are all open (Apache-2.0), which makes it a practical entry point for learning imitation learning and VLA architectures.

Can you try it without a robot? Partly. You can install `lerobot[smolvla]`, load the `lerobot/smolvla_base` checkpoint, and run `select_action` on frames from a dataset like `lerobot/libero` to see predicted actions. Full fine-tuning needs a CUDA GPU, but inference on CPU or Apple Silicon is possible for small batches. The README includes a complete quick-start snippet and training commands.

top.title: nvidia/MotionBricks
top.one_liner: 给人形机器人做动作衔接的实时动作生成模型，不用重新训练就能换目标。
top.one_liner_en: A real-time motion generator that fills in the movement between a humanoid's recent poses and its next target poses.
top.how_to_try: 官方 ONNX 演示要求 NVIDIA 显卡，Mac 上无法直接运行；只能查看项目页视频和 ONNX 导出文档，或用 MPS 自行重写推理。
top.how_to_try_en: Official demo needs an NVIDIA GPU and will not run on a Mac. You can only watch the project-page videos and read the ONNX export docs.
top.reason: 动作衔接生成思路实用、权重开放，但推理依赖 NVIDIA 显卡，无硬件的新人基本只能看演示，被局限为看懂而非亲手运行。
red_flags: 仅有推理权重，无训练流程和数据
官方演示依赖 NVIDIA TensorRT 运行时
标题含 2026 年日期，来源真实性待核实
不适配 from_pretrained，上手门槛高于宣称

top.title: Huy-Quang-Dao/instantTrack
top.one_liner: 让 Unitree G1 人形在三分钟内学会模仿整套动捕动作
top.one_liner_en: Trains a humanoid whole-body motion-tracking policy in about 3 minutes on one GPU.
top.how_to_try: 需 NVIDIA 显卡用 mjlab/MuJoCo Warp 训练，Mac 上基本跑不动；只能看仓库 Demo 视频。
top.how_to_try_en: Needs an NVIDIA GPU with mjlab/MuJoCo Warp; your Mac can't train it. Just watch the demo videos.
top.reason: 训练提速确实亮眼，代码 MIT 开放，但门槛是高端 NVIDIA 显卡，无硬件新人只能看视频理解原理。
red_flags: 需 RTX 5090 级别 GPU，Mac 无法训练
作者与机构信息缺失，尚无论文
速度提升部分自述 p=0.10 未达统计显著

top.title: lerobot/FineART
top.one_liner: 40万集带逐步文字标注的双臂机器人操作数据集，可训练分层VLA模型
top.one_liner_en: A 40k-episode dual-arm robot dataset with step-by-step text labels for training VLA models.
top.how_to_try: Mac上装lerobot，用StreamingLeRobotDataset流式加载少量episode，翻看子任务文字标注；训练需云GPU。
top.how_to_try_en: Install lerobot on Mac, stream a few episodes with StreamingLeRobotDataset and inspect subtask labels; training needs a cloud GPU.
top.reason: 大规模开放+密集子任务标注，学习分层VLA的好材料；但无演示视频、模型链接缺失，且训练需GPU。
red_flags: 模型链接是占位符(TODO)，实际权重可能未公开
只有数据集，没有抓人的演示视频，wow感一般
单一Trossen/ALOHA机器人平台，泛化到其他本体有限
